unit.why: A short anecdote, transmitted from the Rebbe of Ruzhin, about the Maggid of Mezritch: he grieved over his fame, and Heaven revealed it was a punishment for an unnecessary journey on Hol ha-Moed.
unit.boundary_note: Topical heading 'מענין חול המועד' belongs to the previous division; the trailing heading 'מענין חיבורים' introduces the next division.

stories.start_quote: ושמעתי מכה קדוש הרב מראזדעל איך
stories.summary_en: The Maggid of Mezritch was distressed at becoming famous, and Heaven revealed to him that this was a punishment for once travelling needlessly during Hol ha-Moed, which counted as disrespecting the festival.

tags.why: His fame is a heavenly punishment.

quotes: וגילו לו מן השמים שפ״א נסע בחוה״מ
tags.why: Heaven disclosed the cause to him.
